automation.title: Automation
automation.command: The shotsmith command can capture a screen, read text, list presets, and watch a folder.
automation.link: A shotsmith:// link starts a capture. shotsmith://capture/region, shotsmith://capture/text, and shotsmith://capture/scroll are the ones to use.
automation.shortcuts: Apple Shortcuts can open shotsmith://capture/region. The command and the link work on Windows too. This row does not.
plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.off: Plugins are off. Each one runs outside Shotsmith and says what it uploads.
plugins.empty: Put a JSON file in the Plugins folder. It needs id, name, command, and uploads.
language.label: Language
